verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a dedicated rate-limits doc explaining how cached vs uncached tokens count toward TPM limits, and pricing docs state free-tier vs paid-tier scaling (e.g. '10x higher rate limits than free tier', $5 free credit, $10 self-serve paid tier). This gives developers some documented guidance on limits and tier scaling before hitting them, but the evidence pack shows no concrete numeric RPM/TPM tables per tier or enterprise/dedicated tier limits, and a community report describes hitting rate limits abruptly in practice, suggesting real-world limits may be less transparent than expected. Missing for 10: explicit numeric limit tables per tier, dedicated/enterprise tier limit documentation, and corroboration that these limits match documented values in production.
